cohort: 80 pregnant women with autoimmune rheumatic diseases following up at the largest tertiary center in Qatar (Hamad Medical Corporation) between March and December 2020
finding: COVID-19 infection did not significantly affect pregnancy outcomes in women with autoimmune rheumatic diseases.
mod_finding: The study found that COVID-19 infection did not affect the rate of cesarean section in pregnant women with autoimmune rheumatic diseases.
